evolutions.description: Always include a Chinese name after the English name in the frontmatter name field (e.g., name: humanizer 去AI味).

For any future modifications to a skill, do not edit SKILL.md directly. Instead, create/update an evolution.json file in the skill's root directory to store modification suggestions and custom logic. This ensures custom improvements are preserved when the core skill is upgraded.

enhancements: 激活自动化 Stop 钩子机制
自动捕获并持久化 Project-specific 模式和 Workarounds
在 ~/.claude/skills/learned/ 建立动态知识库
